metadata.description: Demute Studio's open repository for the FBX Animation Viewer Reaper extension. Renders animated rigs (glTF, FBX) live, synced to the Reaper transport. Free, MIT-licensed.

reapack.name: FBX Animation Viewer
reapack.desc: Animation rig viewer synced to the Reaper transport

metadata.description: Loads glTF and FBX rigs and renders them live, scrubbed by the Reaper transport. Designed for game audio sound designers. Phase 0: scaffolding only — opens an empty viewer window.

version.name: 0.0.1-phase0
version.author: Demute Studio
version.changelog: Initial scaffolding release. Registers the action "FBXAV: Open Viewer Window" which opens an empty WGL viewer. No mesh loading or animation playback yet.
